Committee lowered the policy rate by 0.25 percentage point to 3.25%.; At that decision, July CPI had risen 0.3% m/m and 12-month CPI was 1.5%.; The Committee described geopolitical uncertainty as high; over its review period the risk premium was around pre-2023-10-07 levels and the exchange rate was virtually unchanged.; Since the prior decision, shekel appreciated 0.6% vs USD, depreciated 1.0% vs EUR, and nominal effective exchange rate depreciated 0.1%.; Q2 GDP grew 15.4% annualized vs Q1 and was 6.2% above Q4 2025; excluding Israeli firms’ foreign production, Q2 was 3.8% above Q4 2025 on an annualized basis.; The BOI said policy path would depend on inflation, activity, geopolitical uncertainty, and fiscal developments.
September CPI decreased 0.5% m/m; 12-month inflation was +1.6% (Sep 2026 vs Sep 2025).; CPI level was 105.3, base average 2024=100.; June–September trend annual inflation was 1.4%.

August monthly activity index +0.4%, representing average monthly estimated GDP-growth over June–August; BOI stated long-run trend about 0.3%.; BOI page says July estimate revised slightly down and June slightly up.; September index is scheduled for 2026-10-20.
